sn54.9:1.2: This episode is told in full as the origin story for the Vinaya rule prohibiting murder (Bu Pj 3), and it is referenced at MN 145:5.32 and SN 35.88:16.2. As a narrative, it is unusual and puzzling in many respects, but the overall message is clear: mindfulness of breathing is a peaceful and wholesome meditation.
sn54.9:1.3: That is, the contemplation of the parts of the body, or the corpse meditations.
sn54.9:3.3: For satthahāraka, see note on SN 35.88:16.2.
sn54.9:3.4: In the Vinaya version, they took their own lives, killed each other, and got the sham monk Migalaṇḍika to kill them.
